description: Print address or product labels on standard sticker sheets as PDF: A4 21/24/14/40/65-up (L7160, L7159, L7163, L7654, L7651 sizes) or Letter 30/10/80-up (5160, 5163, 5167 sizes), or custom geometry in mm. Text modes: "list" (one label per block, blank line between labels), "csv" (rows filled into a template like "{Name}\n{Street}\n{City} {Postcode}", header row or {1},{2}…), or "same" (one text × count). Copies per label, start at a later position to reuse a part-used sheet, alignment, font, size, bold first line, border, shrink-to-fit and printer offset nudges. Print at 100% / actual size. Up to 3000 labels. Latin text only for now. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/label-maker/

border.description: Draw a thin rounded border around each label.

custom.description: preset "custom": paper, cols, rows, w, h, top, left, gx, gy (mm).

fit.description: Shrink text (in 0.5 pt steps, min 5 pt) until it fits the label.

header.description: csv: the first row holds column names.

mode.description: list = blocks separated by a blank line; csv = rows + template; same = one text repeated.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

path.description: Or: a text/CSV file path to read it from.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

startAt.description: Start at this label position on the first sheet (skips used labels).

template.description: csv: template with {Column name} or {1}-style placeholders (empty = all columns, one per line).

text.description: The labels text (list blocks, CSV/TSV, or the single text).

name: doc_labels
title: Label sheets PDF
